svg.title: Isochrones by mode from the Feira de Caruaru
svg.desc: Three maps of the urban area of Caruaru, one per mode, each shading the areas reached from the Feira de Caruaru, in the centre, within 10, 20 and 30 minutes. Walking reaches the centre and the nearby neighbourhoods; cycling most of the urban area; driving, with free-flowing traffic, all of it and the roads out of the city.

g.text: Areas reached within 10, 20 and 30 minutes; urban area of Caruaru. Elevation is not modelled yet:
walking and cycling times are optimistic on its hills
